name: associator_hom_unit_unit
statement: C) : (unit F G).app (x, y) ▷ (H.obj z) ≫ (unit (F ⊛ G) H).app (x ⊗ y, z) ≫ (associator F G H).hom.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) = (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ (F.obj x ◁ (unit G H).app (y, z)) ≫ (unit F (G ⊛ H)).app (x, y ⊗ z) ≫ (F ⊛ G ⊛ H).map (α_ _ _ _).inv

name: associator_inv_unit_unit
statement: C) : F.obj x ◁ (unit G H).app (y, z) ≫ (unit F (G ⊛ H)).app (x, y ⊗ z) ≫ (associator F G H).inv.app (x ⊗ y ⊗ z) = (α_ (F.obj x) (G.obj y) (H.obj z)).inv ≫ (unit F G).app (x, y) ▷ H.obj z ≫ (unit (F ⊛ G) H).app (x ⊗ y, z) ≫ ((F ⊛ G) ⊛ H).map (α_ x y z).hom

name: leftUnitor_hom_unit_app
statement: C) : can ▷ F.obj y ≫ (DayConvolution.unit U F).app (𝟙_ C, y) ≫ (leftUnitor U F).hom.app (𝟙_ C ⊗ y) = (λ_ (F.obj y)).hom ≫ F.map (λ_ y).inv

name: rightUnitor_hom_unit_app
statement: C) : F.obj x ◁ can ≫ (DayConvolution.unit F U).app (x, 𝟙_ C) ≫ (rightUnitor U F).hom.app (x ⊗ 𝟙_ C) = (ρ_ _).hom ≫ F.map (ρ_ x).inv
